actualBodyReasons.facts: Draft restore writes the textarea, renders attachment DOM/listeners, runs autosize (including scrollHeight layout read), advances its own generation and restores history. Clear discards owner attachments and clears input. Resume reset advances its sequence and changes picker DOM; load immediately resets, captures owner/endpoint and begins the model read before its first await. Activity setters capture selection, update tickers/tool state/buttons/status/queue and may patch the selected catalog row. These are observable operations, not commuting pure calls.
actualBodyReasons.disposition: Real composer/resume and sessionActions visibility remain BEFORE D; provisional visibility remains BEFORE D but spawn draft restore/waiting remain AFTER D and pending chrome. No callbacks cross these seams.

actualBodyReasons.facts: Math starts cached local CSS/script loads whose promise executor appends DOM immediately. Reveal traverses session families, expands ancestor keys and persists them. Stream stop advances its own generation, clears reconnect and closes EventSource; terminal close retires pending opens, aborts events, closes socket/disposes xterm and changes panel/status. Extension clear detaches dialogs; relation clear advances request sequence, aborts handlers and clears DOM.
actualBodyReasons.disposition: Real math().catch and reveal remain BEFORE C. Endpoint capture and force-cache deletion also remain before math. C remains before storage/seen/chrome.
